notes.title: A little dose of fixes
notes.content:
Fixes:

[list]
[*] missing translations added - Thank you to our awesome community members! :) 
[*] minor issues in the options panel
[*] the game now acknowledges when you click the rabbit
[*] V-Sync should now be on by default to prevent the smell of melting plastic
[/list]

 If you're experiencing issues with the game please let us know!
